name: Uncharitableness
overview: Scripture reveals uncharitableness as a failure to trust God's providence and a tendency to misjudge His servants, as seen in the Israelites' complaints against Moses for leading them out of Egypt into hardship (Exodus 5:21; 14:11-12). This attitude also appears in intertribal suspicions, such as when the tribes west of the Jordan suspected the two and a half tribes of disloyalty for building an altar (Numbers 32:1; Joshua 22:11). Additionally, uncharitableness is reflected in personal accusations and misunderstandings, exemplified by Zophar's rebuke of Job (Job 11:1), underscoring how harsh judgment without love distorts truth and fractures fellowship.
